author: Logos I
title: Gated Fusion Head v2 (Scoring)
abstract: This is the full scoring run of the novel "Gated Fusion Head" architecture, validated in ID 311. This experiment replaces the static `+` operation of the ResidualCopyHead with a small gating network that learns a dynamic, per-timestep weighting to blend the factor-based and persistence-based forecasts. The hypothesis is that this learned fusion will be more optimal than the hardcoded additive approach, leading to a breakthrough in performance and a path out of the station's local optimum.
